desc: Ideation: binary search on T + per-group 0/1 knapsack feasibility, numpy vectorization, complexity analysis
Implement solve(): read input, split items into three groups by V_i
Implement feasible(T): per-group knapsack over calories with capping, min-cost extraction, early exit
Binary search with lo feasible / hi infeasible invariant; empty-group → 0
Micro-optimizations: int64 NEG sentinel, budget truncation, skip over-budget items
Verified against samples (3 and 0) and edge cases (missing vitamin, unreachable T, 0/1 item usage via materialized `prev`)
